_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Const and High Max use an updated oscillation-envelope estimator on the Arduino Due. Filtered Gaussian peak selection gives the measured crest more influence and limits isolated excursions. Full residual, raw-envelope, SNR and measured-support checks remain. The offline MATLAB implementation includes the corresponding fitter and consensus corrections.

The update also measures missing sampling-edge SNR directly, prevents an unqualified raw diagnostic from vetoing a supported crest, and averages two accepted sampling origins only when they agree within 5 mmHg. It does not apply an arterial-MAP regression correction.

Paired development results, including every 80 mmHg fallback in final-output errors:

| Dataset | Previous final-output MAE | Updated final-output MAE |
|---|---:|---:|
| Firmware replay, 2,825 screened human intervals | 8.57 mmHg | 8.13 mmHg |
| Native MATLAB, same screened intervals | 8.45 mmHg | 8.05 mmHg |
| Firmware replay, 89 historical simulator settings | 9.18 mmHg | 4.52 mmHg |

All 3,024 retained human intervals and 361 older bench files were processed. The latter have no arterial reference; 343 contain no sustained deflation. Existing reference exclusions and calibration overlays were preserved.

Fresh device C testing completed 22 physical settings: 18 accepted targets and four fallbacks, with 100% delivery (103843/103843 frames). Accepted-peak MAE was 3.99 mmHg; final-output MAE was 10.99 mmHg including fallbacks. Two accepted errors exceeded 10 mmHg, with maximum 17.08. Very-low-pressure settings expose the current policy: candidates below 30 return 80. These new acquisitions are not a paired live comparison with the preceding firmware. Simulator references are calculated DBP+(SBP-DBP)/3, not independently measured arterial MAP.

Every physical calculation finished in 6.600-9.507 seconds; accepted estimates finished by 9.193 seconds. STOP during physical calculation reached vented, pump-off IDLE in 0.204 seconds without refill. Protected upload restored and verified device C calibration, PID, valve limits and feedforward.

The 5 dB SNR threshold, >7 dB measured-crest recovery, 0.5-5 Hz Butterworth filter, 30-140 mmHg candidate range, Smart Const 130 mmHg cap, High Max 140 mmHg ceiling, and 80 mmHg rejection fallback remain. Human accepted-error SD remains about 8 mmHg. Pulse-rate artifacts and two additional coherent amplitude-excursion challenges remain unresolved; these development results do not establish clinical MAP accuracy or an optimal subsequent constant-hold pressure.

Validation: 41 numerical/uploader checks, 98 focused GUI/runner/OLED checks, eight MATLAB suites, seven standard GUI/layout/smoke suites, firmware compile and protected device flash passed.

Ten-minute seed-213 soak: all six scored reversal/monotonicity verdicts PASS. Telemetry delivery **100.00% (26782/26782)**.

| Cycle / preset | Measured slope (mmHg/s) | Command (mmHg/s) | Reversal/monotonicity |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 / smart const | 3.58 | 4.00 | PASS |
| 2 / arm cvp | 0.94 | 1.00 | PASS |
| 3 / smart const | 3.60 | 4.00 | PASS |
| 4 / wrist cvp | 0.97 | 1.00 | PASS |
| 5 / regular | 3.61 | 4.00 | PASS |
| 6 / high max | 3.58 | 4.00 | PASS |

Non-CVP slopes are fitted over 150-40 mmHg; CVP uses its full deflation window. Passing the reversal/monotonicity gates does not imply exact slope tracking. Control gains, feedforward, valve limits and timing were unchanged.


Application v3.1.369; firmware rev27v-followup-346, displayed as v3.1.346 dated 11/10/2026. Default channel. The installer is unsigned and distributed with verified size and SHA-256 through the existing update mechanism.

Source commit: `ff42d88e7162e29a4c03ee679c848c2bf011ece3` on Default.
